## Summary

- Problem: v0.32 的 30 个公共命令仍有泛化 failure/remediation、旧 removed-state 正向断言，以及把非 Codex harness 冒充 native adapter 的边界问题。
- Scope: 固化统一 failure/remediation registry；让 stale current、pre-PR build cycle、target、GitHub readback 与 artifact locator 输出单一根因；冻结 Codex-only native harness；将 repo interop 迁移为 external_result_sources/v2；删除旧 carrier/runtime-heavy 默认 aggregate 与对应正向测试。
- Product result: 默认生命周期从显式 Work Item、正式 worktree 与 GitHub host facts 派生，不恢复 current/status/progress/review/shadow/closeout carrier。

## Validation

- [x] Verified locally
- [x] Verified by automation
- [ ] Not applicable

Validation details:
- `python3 src/skills/shared/scripts/loom_check.py --profile source --source-surface source-self-fixture .`: passed。
- `make loom-check`: passed。
- `python3 tools/check_cli_contract.py --surface failure-envelope`: passed。
- `python3 tools/check_cli_contract.py --surface public-default-path`: passed。
- external-result-source-readback contract：failed、stale、wrong-head negatives 均 fail closed。
- `python3 tools/skills_surface.py check`: passed。
- `python3 tools/check_npm_package.py --surface plugin-payload-hash`: 192 files，digest `80e3186b2a354c043c80cd58882b95480d74648f3bcf45500bcbd2ab3871ef0b` matched。
- 基于 main 的 trusted runner + 当前 candidate：delivery-gate-check passed。
- 独立最终语义复核：3 个 P1 finding 均 resolved，无残余 P0/P1 blocker。
- `git diff --check`: passed。

## Risks And Follow-ups

- Risks: hosted gate assurance 仍明确为 `limited`；不宣称 GitHub App hardened identity。
- Follow-ups: 合并后以同一 merge evidence 关闭 covered WI #2126，再 JIT 实施 #2117 residue cleanup，并由唯一 acceptance/release WI 完成 v0.32.0 产品验收、发布和本机升级；不扩大到 WebEnvoy、历史改写、archive registry 或继续拆分 loom_flow.py。

comments.body: Bootstrap exception evidence (current head `78b79de68d963a0dca14823a050bd09838403a45`): the only required failure is base-owned `loom-delivery-gate` run 29288032023. Its primary cause is the clean-main inconsistency `Makefile: pr-metadata-check -> tools/check_cli_contract.py --surface pr-metadata`, while the same clean-main checker reports `unknown surface(s): pr-metadata`. Candidate cannot repair a base-owned overlay. New source-self aggregate, py-compile, PR binding, release judgment, current-head single-maintainer host attestation, candidate agent-harness checker, and old base host-adapter checker all pass. This is a one-time runtime-EOL bootstrap exception; no carrier, hash refresh, transition mechanism, GitHub App, or branch-protection change is introduced.
